title: State import confirmation
description: Review the selected filename, size, Employee, Unit, and View counts before atomically replacing the current state.

title: Invalid state recovery
description: Reject partial, arbitrary, or malformed JSON without changing data and offer an immediate file re-selection action.

title: Direct state Export
description: Download the complete current state in one click, including current in-memory changes.

title: Dark theme
description: Use the expanded sidebar theme menu to choose Light, Dark, or System appearance.

title: Light shell and expanded navigation
description: Inspect the light interface with expanded module labels and locally accessible actions.

title: Russian interface
description: Switch the complete interface in place using the bundled Russian and English catalogs.

title: English language menu
description: Open the English language selector with stable rows, flags, names, and selected state.

title: Team hierarchy and roster
description: Browse the edge-aligned hierarchy, selected path, searchable roster count, and one contiguous direct and descendant Employee list with tags and row actions.

title: Create a manual Team
description: Create a root Team with manual membership and configure its identity and structure.

title: Configure a Live Team
description: Build dynamic membership from Employee birthday, position, tags, and source Team rules.

title: Edit Team assignments
description: Edit a Team, select its boss, and manage Employee positions and membership assignments.

title: Employee catalog
description: Search the complete Employee catalog and use tag, edit, delete, contact, and Team context actions.

title: Compound Employee filters
description: Compose birthday, gender, position, tag, Team, and text criteria with visible match counts.

title: Employee profile and assignments
description: Edit identity, contact, gender, birthday, embedded avatar, tags, Team membership, boss state, and positions.

title: Tag date calendar
description: Apply or clear one exact date for an Employee tag through the localized calendar popover.

title: Employee Team assignments
description: Inspect the lower Employee form with Team membership, boss state, and per-Team positions.

title: Local avatar crop
description: Crop and zoom a local PNG, JPEG, WebP, or pasted image before embedding it into the organization state.

title: Visual organization Editor
description: Arrange opaque Unit cards on the adaptive snap grid with frame-bounded gestures, hierarchy lines, zoom, history, and normal-weight layout controls.

title: Custom View management
description: Switch Views and create an empty or Main-derived independent organization canvas.

title: Editor search
description: Reveal the right-growing search field, locate Units and Employees without leaving the canvas, and clear the query when Search closes.

title: Custom View selection and actions
description: Switch between Main and independent custom Views and access contextual rename and delete actions.

title: Unit context commands
description: Open Unit commands for editing, adding hierarchy, collapse and expand, copy, and local export.

title: Bulk Employee commands
description: Select multiple Employee rows and apply shared boss, tag, edit, copy, or delete actions.

title: Editor image export
description: Preview a local PNG export and choose scope, transparent, solid, or gradient backgrounds.

title: Editor text template export
description: Build a text representation from Employee and Unit tokens with a live preview.

title: Editor image detail settings
description: Configure PNG title, font, spacing, alignment, boss label, and Employee card content below the preview.

title: Organization Analytics
description: Review sortable position, birth month, birthday, first-name, last-name, and full-name distributions.

title: Complete Analytics groups
description: Scroll the unified Analytics surface to inspect the remaining name distributions and bounded groups.

title: Analytics drill-down
description: Open a distribution value to inspect matching Employee cards and their normal actions.

title: Employee Calendar
description: Navigate a monthly calendar with birthdays, uniformly spaced dated-tag counts, events, and a strong current-day state.

title: Calendar day details
description: Open a dated-event date to inspect complete Employee cards, every event label, and right-aligned actions without a redundant section heading.

title: Dated-tag event history
description: Open a tag from the bounded cloud to inspect heading-free current and future events plus conditional past events as complete Employee cards with actions.

title: Template Data Download
description: Configure a separator-based template, row mode, field tokens, live preview, copy, and local download.

title: Download source selection
description: Select Employees from Teams or the catalog, inspect and filter the resulting set, then continue from the shared header.

title: CSV Download settings
description: Choose row behavior and reorder, select, or rename Employee and Team fields for CSV output.

title: JSON Download settings
description: Choose Employee fields and configure the fields of each nested Team object for JSON output.

title: CSV Download preview
description: Inspect the lower field list and live CSV rows before copying or downloading the local file.

title: JSON Download preview
description: Inspect the lower field list and formatted JSON structure before copying or downloading the local file.

title: MCP access consent
description: Review the local full-access boundary and icon-bearing Enable action before enabling MCP.

title: MCP credentials
description: Use icon-bearing Setup and Activity controls, the loopback endpoint, masked token controls, and green enabled sidebar signal.

title: MCP client setup
description: Copy one setup prompt containing the selected skill install, current token, exact client configuration, reload step, and read-only verification.

title: Applied MCP activity
description: Inspect the server-authored summary, actor, reason, revision, and selective Undo action.

title: Selective Undo conflict
description: Block Undo when a later edit changed the same value and identify the exact overlap.
